_comment: Terralith's placement table (Ben, decisions log 2026-10-04, 'Deep Time-side fixes (Recommended)'; research note biome-mods-survey.md sections 7-9; FORMAT.md, 'Pack placement tables'). A JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) on placement.json, applied by the bake when every biome in requires_biomes is registered (the game checks its biome registry: a dedicated server at its first start, the Create World screen for a singleplayer world). Terralith's licence forbids editing or overriding its files, so every change lives here, in Deep Time's own placement data; nothing of Terralith's is copied. Every value is a game choice measured against Terralith 2.6.2's parameter list on a quick 16k planet with MIC (STATUS.md build log; tools/review/terralith_emulate.py, tools/review/terralith-biomes.sh): Am (monsoon forest) is pushed into the wettest humidity band, where Terralith's jungles are, instead of its brushland (BIO-140); Cs (Mediterranean) is squeezed into the driest part of the dry band, Terralith's shrubland, instead of plains, and held to erosion 0.38 and below (reference units, a margin under Terralith's 0.40 where a pack's mapping is the identity): from 0.40 to 0.565 near the coast (continentalness -0.2 to 0.03) every temperate and warm dry slot of Terralith's is windswept savanna, or savanna badlands in the warm band, on either branch of the variant noise, and its shrublands and steppe all end at 0.40 (BIO-141; 2026-10-23, after the flexure merge's test planet put 56 of 96 Cs columns there); BSk (cold steppe) takes the same dry band and is held to the erosion that reaches Terralith's steppe (reference 0.12 to 0.38, which MIC's climate mapping turns into about 0.11 to 0.30, inside Terralith's 0.05 to 0.40; 0.38 rather than 0.40 since 2026-10-23, the margin Cs has, as 0.40 ties the steppe's edge where a pack's mapping is the identity; BIO-142); ET (tundra) takes the positive branch of the variant noise, so its flats get Terralith's gravel desert rather than snowy plains and its peaks frozen peaks (BIO-143); and a class rule puts humid tropical mountains (Cfb, Cwb, Cfc, Cwc below 25 degrees of latitude, above 1,000 m, P/PET above 1) in Terralith's cloud forest slot: the cold band, humidity band 3 and up, erosion 0.62 and up, far inland (BIO-144 to BIO-146).

class_rules.name: cloud_forest
class_rules._comment: Tropical montane cloud forest: humid mountains of the tropics (BIO-144: below 25 degrees, BIO-145: above 1,000 m, P/PET above 1), drawn in Terralith's cloud forest slot (BIO-146).
